title: Scenario 1: Critical Billing Overcharge & Double Debit
text: URGENT: I was double-charged on invoice INV-88942 for our enterprise subscription. The charge of $4,950.00 was debited twice from our corporate card this morning. Please reverse the duplicate charge immediately and confirm credit. This is holding up our monthly account reconciliation.

title: Scenario 2: Critical Production API Outage (500 Error)
text: CRITICAL EMERGENCY: The Payment Checkout API gateway is returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors across all US-East clusters. Error code ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_504 is spiking to 87%. Our merchant checkouts are completely blocked! Escalate to on-call infrastructure lead immediately!

title: Scenario 3: Standard Account Feature Inquiry
text: Hello, our compliance team is evaluating your platform for our Q1 expansion. Could you clarify whether your audit logging module supports role-based access control (RBAC) and data retention exports in JSON format? Also, what are your standard support operating hours?
